topic: Dashboard release notes and time scale adjustments
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the release process for a new Dashboard design. Initially, there was confusion regarding whether a formal version number or just a date should be used in the release notes. It was decided that using the release date (Oct 07, 2021) was sufficient and would prevent delays.

Separately, feedback was received regarding time scale limitations for reporting working hours. A request was made to extend the selectable period from 06:00–24:00 to include times until 01:00 (the next day). It was proposed that this functionality could be implemented by using an 'inverted' time scale, where selecting a range like 01:00-06:00 and checking an 'invert timeline' box would achieve the desired filtering effect.
decisions: The release notes for the Dashboard should use the date (Oct 07, 2021) instead of a formal version number.
The time scale limitation can be addressed by implementing an 'inverted' timeline filter.
action_items: Implement the inverted timeline functionality in the dashboard to allow selection of non-standard working hours (e.g., 01:00–06:00).
